text_block_list.text:
After finishing the shopping and entering 
the Trainer's office, Ikuno Dictus was 
waiting there.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally left my notebook here. Now 
that I've safely retrieved it, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If I'm not mistaken, that paper bag is 
from a bookstore...
choice_data_list: Yeah, a new volume just came out.

text_block_list.text:
I pull out a manga I picked up while out 
shopping. It's a series I've followed 
since its serialization began. Its title 
is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Geki☆Sto"...!?

"Fierce ☆ Hot-Blooded Striker." A soccer 
manga celebrating its 10th anniversary of 
serialization.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have all the volumes. It's a 
masterpiece among sports manga, ...and it 
holds a special place in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However... Is that so, Trainer?
choice_data_list: By the way, which scene was your favorite?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is quite hard to choose... but perhaps 
we should go with the very first episode, 
where it all began.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many shots I take or how 
much training I do, I just can't score a 
point.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Gradually, he became reluctant to aim for 
the goal. And to him—the captain offered 
these words.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“Failure is proof of having challenged 
yourself.”
choice_data_list:
Those words really give you a push 
forward, huh.

Those words really give you a push 
forward, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The first time I read it, I was deeply 
shocked.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Because it was the same for me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
'I want to become an Umamusume who can 
keep running for a long time.' Back then, 
that was the decision I made right as I 
began running.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Still, of course it didn't immediately 
lead to results—

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text:
"I've finished reading everything on the 
sports theory shelf! Is there anything 
else that could be useful...?"

text_block_list.name: Bookstore Clerk
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... Then how about this one? I think 
you'll learn a lot from it."

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text: "Is this... a manga?"

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text:
“Failure is proof of having challenged 
yourself—”

text_block_list.name: Young Ikuno
text_block_list.text:
""......H-Huh? Why... why am I 
crying...?""

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I have been utterly 
captivated. Captivated by so-called 
"sports-guts" manga.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To move forward, you need more than just 
knowledge. You need emotional support—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Courage is necessary too, after all.
choice_data_list: I know exactly how you feel.

text_block_list.text:
Characters who strive toward their dreams 
can energize even the reader. That's what 
I love about stories too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. What other kinds of manga do you 
enjoy?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If you'd be willing to share it with me. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let us talk like this again sometime.
choice_data_list:
If we're talking popular works, 
"Supersonic Winning Shot of Love"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that baseball manga that just started 
serialization the other day! Nobunaga 
slips through time and plays baseball...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll start reading it 
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-san, it's almost your turn for the 
bath—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: !? Is that... a-a baseball manga...!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ? Ah, it was recently recommended to me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's quite entertaining. Nobunaga stepping 
up to the plate holding a katana, and so 
on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Is that a baseball manga?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ho... If I recall, that's a romance-genre 
golf manga, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I haven't read much romance fiction, 
but... this is a good opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Mornin'... wait.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Is that thing on the desk 'KoiSho'? 
That's such a trendy romance manga!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was recommended to me. I found it very 
informative as I read through it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hohohohoh~? Romance manga can serve as a 
reference, you say~...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
How to train the core, how not to let 
personal troubles affect performance. And 
also—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Don't beat around the bush with what 
you're thinking. Say it straight.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is a masterpiece that teaches us 
precisely that.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
An airheaded heroine...! Going down that 
character route sounds great too.
